STORYPROP.description: Story Property (STORYPROP). Computes per-story properties (weight, elevation, loaded dimensions) for wind/seismic lateral load setup; the optional Argument fields only control the output units, numeric format, and decimal places used to render the result strings.

Argument.description: Optional display controls for the story property result. All fields are optional; if omitted the current model units are used and defaults are applied.

FORCE_UNIT.description: Force unit used to express weights in the result. Case-insensitive. If omitted, the model's current base force unit is used.

LENGTH_UNIT.description: Length unit used to express elevations and loaded dimensions in the result. Case-insensitive. If omitted, the model's current base length unit is used.

FORMAT.description: Numeric formatting of the result string values: 'Fixed' uses fixed-point notation, 'Scientific' uses exponential notation. Case-insensitive.

PLACE.description: Number of decimal places used when formatting result values. Note: the handler currently forces this to 4 regardless of the value supplied.
